scope: cols shows the exact end-of-match flag: playerState field 83 = 6 marks intermission

finding.meaning: intermission - the client's 0x41dba0 case 6 skips movement and weapons, i.e. the match is ending
finding.context: written only when PlayerVitals.intermission is true; otherwise field 83 carries PM_DEAD (8) or nothing

implication: this is the game-side end-of-match signal we were looking for - the connection-based approaches all failed
to use it on 1649370 we must send a playerState block containing field 83 = 6
our hybrid body has no playerState payload at all (only the 1-bit 'no change' path), so the next step is to learn the ps block encoding
next: read cols' playerState writer to learn how (index, value, bits) triples are serialised (the last/distance grammar)
then emit a minimal ps block carrying only field 83 = 6 and test whether the client enters intermission
